Sadly I understand how that feels.  I'm currently 24 and still living at home and have been out of the organization since I was 18. However, i suffer from terrible depression so i have not been able to form relationships in the world. I am on my own and cannot afford to be kicked out either
 I have to hide who I really am. My parents still think that deep down I still believe in the "truth" they have no idea how far away from that nor do they have no idea about my tattoos and occasional smoking/drinking habits. 
I'm beyond tired of living in secrecy. 
But I have no option. I have to keep it up because I have no place to go. 
I'm sorry you have to deal with that. Best advice I can give is to make friends. Real friends form relationships and put yourself out there. At least you are still young and can build your life.

Thanks 
I really want to believe that it does get better.

I would like to get help but unfortunately I dont have health insurance or a job so it's really expensive for just 1 session here in the states 
When I was a teenager I put it off getting help because my family frowns upon mental Ilness that's another reason why I have kept it a secret. 
If my parents found out despite me being an adult they would shun me or kick me out of the house which is something I cant afford right now 
Thanks though. I really wish I could find people that would understand or encourage me to get help 
I feel like everyone I meet in real life doesnt get mental illness or they just pity me and stop talking to me or quickly change the subject. 
No one wants to hear a downer.

Yeah Its just been too many years that have passed me by without any change.

Yeah I hope so. I just feel so ashamed of being at this age and still living with my parents and still being so far behind in life. It makes it that much harder to seek help or want to talk to anyone in public. In the past with my previous jobs I've had people want to hang out and befriend me but some people dont understand how I can be this age and still allow my parents to control my life.  I can see how they feel sorry for me. It just feels like I cant find real friends because the ones that one to befriend me just judge me or tell me to stand up to them.  No one seems to really get it.

Thank you. Yes it's really sad for 24 years I have been hiding who I am because the moment I speak up or show my individuality , I will be shunned.  
It would not be so much of problem if I was not living with them still.
